CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), organization (spatial positions pattern) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change statement linked to the same identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Identifies content (red) and its positional attribute explicitly.

D.rationale: Separately reports an origin/status field for the same identified content (distinguishing content identity from status/origin).

O.rationale: Specifies how the content is presented/organized via explicit spatial position listings.
